claim_definition: Verifies that a GPU Confidential Compute attestation report (NVIDIA H100/H200/Blackwell CC mode) has the correct structure: report_type GPU_CC, a known GPU model identifier, a valid SHA-256 runtime measurement, and PCR values present. This establishes the conformance baseline for hardware-rooted GPU inference attestation, the compute substrate root-of-trust for DGV Level 1 and above.
scope: NVIDIA GPU CC attestation report structure; DGV Level 1 compute substrate; hardware root-of-trust for AI inference
excluded_scope: Full NVIDIA RATS attestation chain verification; GPU CC mode enablement procedures; GH200 Grace-Hopper NVLink topology attestation

test_cases.description: A well-formed GPU_CC attestation report for an H100 with a valid SHA-256 measurement and PCR values present is accepted, confirming hardware-rooted compute substrate attestation.
A report with a malformed measurement field and missing PCR values is rejected. The missing_fields list identifies both deficiencies for remediation.
